scenario: AITA for telling my girlfriend that I don't care about what she is talking about? | Throwaway account. Last night my girlfriend and I were hanging out on the couch. Well she got super pissed by my comment and said "I listen to you talk about stuff that I don't care about" then she left my house. I didn't hear from her for the rest of the night and today she is talking to me but only one or two word responses. So AITA?
